answer: In the haven registry, each guarantor's vouching budget halves after every vouch: 64, 32, 16... so one sponsor can back at most 7 accounts. Faking 1,000 accounts needs about 143 real guarantors, each locking a copper bond that is slashed, and its budget zeroed, if an audit finds a vouched account is fake. Colluders cannot pool budgets because halving is per guarantor. An honest newcomer joins the sparrow tier with a single vouch, so real users pay almost nothing.
